name: Hairy Woodpecker
desc: Hairy Woodpecker (Leuconotopicus villosus): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 1,421 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The hairy woodpecker is a medium-sized woodpecker that is found over a large area of North America. It is approximately 250 mm (9.8 in) in length with a 380 mm (15 in) wingspan.
